_comment: Ingest metadata for the dev guideline corpus (ARCH-038 / ARCHITECTURE.md §5.1). Copy to manifest.json (gitignored) and fill/confirm every field before ingestion. Metadata is NEVER inferred from PDF metadata. One entry per file in SAMPLE_GUIDELINES_DIR; the key is the exact filename.
_licence_warning: Confirm each document's licence and permitted use before ingesting or redistributing. WHO publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO but verify per document. Government-of-Kenya / Ministry of Health publications: usage terms to be confirmed with the publisher.

_fields.title: string (required)
_fields.format_profile: grade_recommendations | clinical_protocol | narrative (optional; detected if omitted)
_fields.topic_tags: array of strings for coverage tracking
_fields.source_pages: OPTIONAL array of ints — only when this file is a partial page-range extract of a larger publication (e.g. 4 pages pulled out of a 100-page guideline). One entry per physical page in THIS file, in order, giving that page's true page number in the original publication (e.g. [42, 43, 44, 45]). Ingestion remaps every chunk's page_start/page_end through this so citations point at the real document's pagination, not the extract's own 1..N (DEVIATIONS.md #166). Omit entirely for a document ingested in full. Must have exactly one entry per page in the file, in ascending order — ingestion rejects (fails closed) any mismatch rather than silently mislabeling citations.
_fields.boilerplate_patterns: OPTIONAL array of regexes (layout parser, ARCH-044) — extra running header/footer text to drop from the page margins when the layout labels and the repeated-text rule miss it (the repeat rule needs >= INGEST_BOILERPLATE_MIN_PAGES pages).
_fields.text_corrections: OPTIONAL array (layout parser, ARCH-044 / DEVIATIONS.md #214) — operator-attested fixes of evident source errors or wrong OCR readings: {id, page (source page), original, corrected, kind: erratum|ocr_override, rationale, evidence, attested_by, attested_on}. `corrected` must keep every number and unit of `original` and may only add/remove relational words (less/more/than/equal/or/not…). `original` must match exactly once on that page or ingestion stops. Every citation of corrected text shows the correction.
_fields.flowchart_attestations: OPTIONAL array (layout parser, ARCH-044) — operator-confirmed flowchart edges the geometry couldn't verify: {from_text, to_text, label?, attested_by, attested_on}, where from_text/to_text are prefixes of the two boxes' text.
_fields.table_sources: OPTIONAL array (vision-LLM table transcription, ARCH-044 D12 / DEVIATIONS.md #219) — per-table source choice applied on every ingest: {page (source page), table_index (0-based, reading order on that page), source: ocr|vlm, reason, decided_by?}. Use source=ocr to keep a table off the vision path, e.g. after a reviewer rejected its transcription. Either way the table stays held for admin review while it contains OCR'd or transcribed numbers.
_fields.ocr_prose_source: OPTIONAL "ocr" | "vlm" (DEVIATIONS.md #222) — OCR'd prose (text, list items, captions, footnotes) is transcribed by the vision model by default; set "ocr" to keep this document's OCR prose as OCR.
